title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Wall Mount Triple Tier With Towel Bar Solid Brass | Allied Brass
short_title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier With Towel Bar | Allied Brass
description:
Add organized storage to your bathroom with a 16-Inch wall mount glass shelf featuring three tiers and an integrated towel bar. Built with solid brass hardware and 3/8-inch thick tempered glass for strength and everyday use.

Highlights:
- Triple-tier glass shelf adds vertical storage for toiletries and decor
- Integrated towel bar keeps hand towels within reach
- 3/8-inch thick tempered glass with beveled edges for safety and a finished look
- Solid brass hardware with concealed screw mounting
- Multiple finish options available, including statement colors

Specs:
- Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 Inches
- Overall size: 16-Inch L x 5-Inch W x 18-Inch H
- Weight capacity: 6 lb
- Mounting: wall mount; concealed screws
- Assembly: not required
- Included: glass shelf and all installation hardware (screws #8 x 1 1/4)
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.description: Add space and organization to your bathroom with this simple, contemporary style glass shelf. Featuring tempered, beveled-edged glass and solid brass hardware this shelf is crafted for durability, strength and style. Integrated towel bar provides space for your favorite decorative towels or for your everyday use. One of the many coordinating accessories in the Allied Brass Collection of products, this subtle glass shelf is the perfect complement to your bathroom decor.
